hive-formatter.config.schemaCache.prefet: Whether to asynchronously prefetch Schema cache after database connection.
hive-formatter.config.lint.missing_query: Configure the `missing_query_comment` rule (complex queries missing explanatory comments).
hive-formatter.config.lint.missing_colum: Configure the `missing_column_comment` rule (DDL column definitions missing COMMENT).
hive-formatter.config.lint.commented_out: Configure the `commented_out_code` rule (suspected large blocks of commented-out code).

hive-formatter.config.lint.reserved_word: Configure the `reserved_word_identifier` rule (reserved word used as identifier).

hive-formatter.config.lint.misplaced_dis: Configure the `misplaced_distinct` rule (DISTINCT in wrong position).
hive-formatter.config.lint.aggregate_in_: Configure the `aggregate_in_where` rule (aggregate function in WHERE clause).
hive-formatter.config.lint.suspicious_nu: Configure the `suspicious_null_comparison` rule (NULL compared with = or !=).
hive-formatter.config.lint.redundant_dis: Configure the `redundant_distinct` rule (redundant DISTINCT in COUNT).
hive-formatter.config.lint.date_function: Configure the `date_function_usage` rule (date function usage hint).
hive-formatter.config.lint.wildcard_in_u: Configure the `wildcard_in_update` rule (wildcard in UPDATE statement).
